brief:
A settler sustained injuries Wednesday evening after being struck by a farm tractor in Mukhmas, northeast of occupied Jerusalem, the Shehab Wire reported. The incident took place as the settler was engaging in an attack on Palestinian-owned land in the village.

The tractor collision left the settler wounded, though the extent of injuries remained unclear in immediate reports. The circumstances surrounding the operation—whether the tractor was operated by Palestinians defending their property or involved in other activity—were not detailed in the account.
